Name: Magnetic Chests - Auto-Deposit Matching Chest Items
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[size=5][b][center]Magnetic Chests + Fridge[/center][/b][/size][center]﻿[/center][center][size=3][b]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.[/b][/size][/center]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][center]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/center]
[/url]﻿[/size]
[b]Turn your storage into magnets that automatically pull matching items from your inventory as you walk by.
[/b]
Magnetic Chests is a quality-of-life mod that automatically deposits items from your backpack into nearby chests—but only if that chest [b]already contains[/b] that item.

It allows you to clear your inventory just by running through your shed or kitchen, without ever opening a menu.
[line]
[size=4][b]Features
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Magnetic Pull:[/b] Simply walk within range of a chest (default: 1.5 tiles), and compatible items will instantly transfer from your backpack to the chest.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Smart Stacking:[/b] The mod only deposits items that stack with items [b]already inside[/b] the chest. It will never dump random new items into the wrong boxes, preserving your specific chest layout.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Kitchen Friendly:[/b] Works with the Farmhouse Fridge. Walk into your kitchen to instantly stash your crops and cooking ingredients.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Visual Feedback:[/b] A floating message (e.g., "+10 Wood") appears above your head so you know exactly what was moved.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Safety First:[/b]
[/list][b]
[/b][list]
[list]
[*][b]Tools are safe:[/b] The mod will never take your tools.
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][b]Menu Cooldown:[/b] After you close a chest menu, the mod pauses for 5 seconds (configurable). This prevents the chest from immediately "stealing" an item back if you just took it out to use it.
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer Safe:[/b] Checks if chests are currently in use by other players to prevent item loss or duplication glitches.
[/list][/list][list]
[list]
[center][youtube]a59pXLIdy48[/youtube][/center][/list][/list][size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
This mod supports [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] for easy in-game configuration. You can change:

[list]
[*][b]Enable/Disable:[/b] Turn the entire mod on or off without uninstalling.
[*][b]Trigger Range:[/b] How close you need to stand to a chest (Default: 1.5 tiles).
[*][b]HUD Messages:[/b] Turn the floating text notification on or off.
[*][b]Sound:[/b] Adjust how often the sound effect plays.
[*][b]Menu Cooldown:[/b] Adjust how long the mod waits after you close a menu before it starts working again.
[/list]
